skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand foundational issues about taxation from both economic and legal perspectives, including key aspects of tax law such as tax policy and tax administration.
Demonstrate the ability to find and retrieve legal documents and statutes.
Apply skills in analyzing and synthesizing information to resolve legal issues.
Apply skills in working effectively in a group setting.
Apply skills in communication, presentation, and public speaking.
Demonstrate the ability to engage in self-directed learning and accumulate knowledge and experience to enhance professional competence.
